note: GPL-3.0, backend only. Direct dependency babyjubjub-rs 0.0.11 pulls it in. src/verifier/kyc.rs and primitives/eddsa.rs call babyjubjub_rs::verify with no feature gate, so it is compiled into tee-server in every image.

name: fuchsia-cprng
evidence: The crate's own LICENSE file (crates.io tarball, 0.1.1) is the BSD 3-clause text, Copyright 2019 The Fuchsia Authors; Cargo.toml declares license-file = LICENSE.
note: Only a Fuchsia-target dependency of rand 0.4.6 (cfg target_os = fuchsia), which poseidon-rs pulls in. Not compiled on Linux.

name: ring
evidence: The crate's own LICENSE file (crates.io tarball, 0.17.8): ISC-style for new code, MIT for third_party/fiat, plus the OpenSSL and SSLeay licence texts inherited from BoringSSL. Cargo.toml declares license-file = LICENSE only.
note: Reached through rustls (used by sqlx, hyper-rustls, reqwest). Permissive.

name: fastrlp
note: MPL-2.0, file-level copyleft, no modification known. Reached through ruint from alloy (feature chain, built into both images).

name: webpki-roots
note: MPL-2.0 data crate (root certificates), unmodified. Reached through hyper-rustls, reqwest and sqlx-core.

name: webpki-roots
note: CDLA-Permissive-2.0 is a permissive data licence. Reached through hyper-rustls, reqwest and sqlx-core.

name: webpki-root-certs
note: CDLA-Permissive-2.0 is a permissive data licence. Reached through rustls-platform-verifier.

name: r-efi
note: Dual licence; take Apache-2.0 or MIT. getrandom only depends on it for the uefi target with the efi_rng backend; not compiled on Linux.

name: aws-lc-*
note: Permissive terms throughout (the OR clauses all include a permissive option). Reached through rustls and quinn-proto.
Dual licence with a permissive option; take the permissive one. Not traced (some, such as wasi and wit-bindgen-rt, are target-specific).

name: node-forge
note: Dual (BSD-3-Clause OR GPL-2.0); take BSD-3-Clause. Direct dependency of jwt-input-generator, imported by index.ts.

name: rapidsnark*
note: LGPL-3.0 (its README and COPYING at the pinned SHA). Compiled from source in the image (build_gmp.sh and cmake in /rapidsnark) and run as a separate prover process by tee-server; it is not linked into the Rust binary. Its own submodules: ffiasm LGPL-3.0, circom_runtime Apache-2.0, nlohmann/json MIT, pistache Apache-2.0.
